messages:
PagerBot: INCIDENT PAGER — Inference runtime (eu-west-1) elevated 5xx and tail latency. Primary: @Aisha. Severity: SEV-2. Link: <https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-1123>

Aisha: I'm seeing the pager — I'm actually out for the weekend sprint starting 22:00 UTC, was hoping the scheduled shadow would pick this up. I'm not able to stay online for the next 6h. Can someone take primary? :grimacing:

Carlos: I can take this primary for now. Picking up at 3849876600 UTC. What's the current impact?

PagerBot: Metrics snapshot — 5xx rate 2.8% (baseline 0.08%), p95 latency 920ms, request volume normal. Affected routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Approx ~18 customers seeing errors, no full outage.

Marta: I'll shadow Carlos. If you take primary, Carlos, follow the inference-high-err runbook (RunbookBot link below). I'll handle support comms.

Carlos: Taking primary. Quick diagnostics I ran: checked pods in eu-west-1, saw a small spike of OOMKilled workers on worker-deploy-3. Not sure if it's memory leak or sudden batch profile.

Devon: If it's OOMs, try draining the problematic node set and re-schedule workers. Command we use:```bash
kubectl cordon node/node-ml-12 && kubectl delete pod -l app=inference-worker -n inference --field-selector=status.phase=Failed
```Also increase worker instance memory to 192Gi if you need to keep throughput.

Carlos: Running checks now. Also toggled temporary routing fallback to smaller model variant to reduce memory pressure:```curl -X POST https://router.internal/route/update -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"rdw-llm-small"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```

Aisha: Thanks. Two notes before I hand off: 1) If you flip routing, expect degraded responses (shorter context). 2) Support escalation template: "Customers seeing 5xx may see degraded quality while we fail over to small model."

RunbookBot: Runbook: inference-high-err-rate — primary checklist:
 - Verify pod health and OOMs
 - Check kv-cache memory evictions
 - Toggle routing to smaller model / enable cache-only for frequent prefixes
 - Open infra ticket for node drain if OOM pattern repeats
 - Notify Support with customer impact note
Link: https://runbooks.internal/inference-high-err-rate

Marta: Support update drafted: "We observed an elevated error rate (5xx) impacting some inference requests in eu-west-1. Our engineers are investigating and have applied a temporary routing fallback to a smaller model to reduce memory pressure. Some requests may be returned with shorter contexts. We'll follow up when fully remediated." Want me to send?

Carlos: Please send. Also posting Ops note in #incidents once we confirm node drains. I'll watch logs for KV cache evictions (grep for 'kv_cache_evict').

SupportBot: Ticket created: SUP-7892 (customers: 3 enterprise accounts) — Support will notify affected customers via standard SLA path.

Marta: Sent support comms and pinged the 3 accounts. Told them estimated mitigation window ~30-90m while we stabilize.

Devon: If draining doesn't help, escalate to infra to check kernel OOM settings; we saw similar intermittent OOM patterns when batch size auto-scaling misreported seq lengths. Also check batching-service metrics: batch_size_histogram.

Carlos: Node drain in progress. Re-scheduled 4 pods, one created with higher mem req. Early signs: 5xx dropping to 0.6%, p95 latency down to 460ms.

Aisha: Appreciate the quick cover — tagging ops-runbook: when you hand back primary, please paste the small checklist I left in #eng-oncall:
 - Confirm 5xx at baseline for 15m
 - Revert routing fallback during low load window
 - Capture runbook steps taken in the incident ticket (INC-2026-1123)
 - Note any config changes (mem requests, node labels)

Carlos: Will do. Planning to keep primary until 3849879000 UTC (about +2400s). Marta will shadow then take over for the rest of the weekend if needed.

Marta: I'll be on for handoff at 3849879000. Quick reminder to document exact mem changes and the curl routing command in the incident notes.

PagerBot: UPDATE — 5xx rate now 0.4%, p95 420ms. Incident state: stabilizing.

Carlos: Leaving a short postmortem draft in the ticket with timeline and remediation steps. Handing off primary to Marta now. Marta, you're primary — ping me if anything spikes.

Marta: Got it, taking primary. Thanks everyone. I'll monitor for the next 2 hours then release unless anything pops.

Aisha: Thanks team. I'm back Monday morning but I appreciate the handoff. :raised_hands:
